categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in R&D, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor back-end packaging and testing specialized equipment. Its main products include semiconductor automated testing systems, semiconductor laser marking equipment, and other electromechanical integration devices. It focuses on power semiconductor testing systems, analog and mixed-signal integrated circuit testing systems, and laser marking equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor testing technologies including wafer probing, final testing, and dynamic parameter testing for power devices such as diodes, MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC, and GaN devices. It uses proprietary automated testing platforms (QT-4000, QT-8400, QT-8000 series) and laser marking technologies integrating CO2, fiber, and green lasers. Production involves in-house electronic processing, assembly, software development, with outsourcing of mature, low-value processes like mechanical parts and cable processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international semiconductor manufacturers and packaging/testing companies such as ON Semiconductor, Littelfuse, Vishay, China CRRC, Sanan Optoelectronics, BYD Semiconductor, and others. The company serves the semiconductor back-end testing market, focusing on power semiconductors, analog/mixed-signal ICs, and third-generation semiconductors for automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with sales and service networks covering South China, East China, North China, Southwest China, and Southeast Asia. It has subsidiaries and service points in Foshan, Shanghai, Chengdu, Suzhou, Wuxi, Beijing, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, supporting both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, providing specialized equipment for the back-end packaging and testing phase. It supplies automated test systems and laser marking equipment to semiconductor packaging and testing enterprises, interfacing with chip design firms and packaging/testing manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in power semiconductor testing, especially for third-generation materials like SiC and GaN, and expanding into integrated circuit testing including analog, mixed-signal, digital, and SoC chips. The company emphasizes innovation in high-voltage, high-current dynamic testing technologies and aims to enhance product performance and service capabilities. It invests heavily in R&D (37.77% of revenue in 2024) and talent development to maintain technological leadership and support domestic substitution of imported equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor automated testing systems, laser marking equipment, and related electromechanical devices to semiconductor packaging and testing companies. The company mainly uses a direct sales model, engaging closely with customers for technical customization and after-sales service. It also has a minor portion of revenue from accessories, maintenance, and technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor test equipment market is dominated by three major players: Advantest, Teradyne, and COHU. The company is one of the leading domestic suppliers in China, especially in power semiconductor testing and third-generation semiconductor testing, achieving significant progress in import substitution. It competes with domestic firms like Huafeng Testing, Changchuan Technology, and Hongbang Electronics, leveraging its technological depth, product breadth, and local service advantages to maintain a leading market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 311.25 million, a 31.6% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 20.3 million, down 17.41% due to increased R&D and stock-based compensation expenses, though adjusted net profit excluding these factors showed strong growth. The company maintains a robust R&D investment, with RMB 117.55 million spent in 2024, representing 37.77% of revenue. It has a workforce of 712 employees, with 284 in R&D, and continues to expand its market and product lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive semiconductor testing solutions with broad coverage of power devices and integrated circuits, featuring high-voltage, high-current, and dynamic parameter testing capabilities. Its QT-4000 and QT-8400 series platforms provide one-stop testing solutions for mainstream and third-generation semiconductors, achieving domestic import substitution with competitive cost-performance ratios. The company emphasizes localized sales and service, rapid technical support, and continuous innovation to meet evolving customer needs in automotive, industrial, and new energy markets.
